FAQ

Is Perastage a real-time DMX visualizer?

No. It focuses on scene editing, MVR review and technical documentation. See the Feature Overview.

What is the difference between PSTG and MVR?

PSTG preserves Perastage project context, layouts and project symbols for continued editing. MVR exchanges scene data with other applications. See Opening MVR Files.

Which desktop platforms are supported?

Windows, macOS and Linux. See Installation and the packages available for your release.

Can Perastage import and export MVR?

Yes, including opening a new project or merging into the current project. See Opening MVR Files.

What is the MVR / GDTF Inspector? Is it read-only?

It browses project snapshots or external packages, definitions, resources and diagnostics without modifying the project or file. See Inspector.

Can Perastage download GDTFs?

Yes, through Tools → Download GDTF, with a GDTF Share account and network access. See GDTF Download.

Can I browse the cached GDTF catalog offline?

Yes, if a usable cache already exists. Downloading still requires online authentication. See cached browsing.

Are layouts and PDF supported?

Yes. Compose printable pages and export the selected layout with File → Print Layout.... See Layouts and PDF.

Where are logs? How do I report a useful problem?

Use Help → Open Logs Folder and Help → Export Diagnostic Report.... Include reproduction steps and review files before sharing. See Troubleshooting.

Is external automation available?

OSC and MCP integration are experimental local integrations requiring separate setup. See the developer integration documentation and MCP adapter. For everyday embedded commands, see Shortcuts and Command Bar.
